hypothesis: The decisive Phase-31 Hamilton-Jacobi ID-h8 failure is caused by horizon mismatch in the context-only damping guard: a lambda that is optimal over a 3-step context rollout can still be unstable over a longer recursive rollout. A forward-chaining multihorizon guard should detect such instability using only observed context frames and reduce long-horizon failures without family labels or future targets.

frozen_scientific_configuration.phase30_82_group_rule: unchanged shared-support 82-feature group enabled per split iff median heldout 82-vs-62 gain > 0.10

phase32_only_change.name: forward_chaining_multihorizon_context_guard
phase32_only_change.per_window_score: per-trajectory recursive-rollout MSE divided by same-window persistence MSE plus 1e-30
phase32_only_change.candidate_score: per-trajectory maximum normalized score across the 5-step, 4-step, and 3-step windows
phase32_only_change.selection: choose lambda with minimum candidate score independently per trajectory; exact ties prefer larger lambda because the frozen grid is descending
phase32_only_change.scientific_forecast: after lambda selection, refit the Phase-30/31 scientific forecast maps on the unchanged full context and apply the selected lambda recursively for the held-out h3/h8 target
phase32_only_change.isolation_intent: No new feature family, no family-specific branch, no new model class, and no damping-grid expansion are introduced so that the registered test isolates guard-horizon choice.

registered_gate.pass: All three fresh registered replicates must beat raw persistence on all 23 frozen primary splits: 69/69 selected ratios strictly below 1.0.
registered_gate.fail: Any valid registered primary selected ratio >= 1.0 is a decisive Phase-32 FAIL. Once such a cell exists, later registered replicates remain unconsumed and must not be run.
registered_gate.retry_policy: No retry, rerun, redispatch, replacement seed, or post-result gate modification is permitted for a consumed valid registered attempt. Infrastructure failure is not scientific evidence and must be handled under a separately documented repair namespace if governance permits.
registered_gate.claim_limit: Synthetic benchmark evidence only; not evidence of new physics, unrestricted scientific-law discovery, AGI, or SSI.

fraction of trajectories whose Phase-32 lambda differs from the Phase-31 3-step-only lambda when both are computed context-only

authorization_boundary: Engineering implementation and seedless validation are allowed. No registered Phase-32 seed may be consumed until a separate explicit scientific-execution authorization is recorded.
